user_intent: Requesting a serial dilution protocol to run on a Hamilton STAR liquid handler.
primary_api_or_format: Hamilton VENUS 6 methods (.med) with HSL scripting (.hsl). ([labautowiki.org](https://labautowiki.org/wiki/HSL_%26_Venus_%28Hamilton%29?utm_source=openai))
PyHamilton (Python library controlling STAR via VENUS OEM interface). ([github.com](https://github.com/dgretton/pyhamilton?utm_source=openai))

tools.name: Hamilton VENUS 6 Run Control (Simulation Mode)
tools.notes: Official VENUS supports running methods in Simulation mode without a connected instrument; useful for validating method logic, deck configuration, and compile-time checks. ([hamiltoncompany.com](https://www.hamiltoncompany.com/automated-liquid-handling/training/vb_r_pac26.04?utm_source=openai))
tools.usage_example: Open VENUS Run Control, enable Simulation Mode, then load and run the .med method to dry-run steps and check for errors.

tools.name: PyHamilton (simulate=True)
capabilities: Python-level syntax/type linting via external tools
basic API call validation during script run
tools.notes: Community library to control STAR/STARlet; supports running scripts with simulate=True on a PC not connected to a robot. Not officially endorsed by Hamilton. ([github.com](https://github.com/dgretton/pyhamilton?utm_source=openai))
tools.usage_example: Within a Python script, open HamiltonInterface(simulate=True) and run initialization calls to validate flow without hardware.

simulation_validation.notes: VENUS Simulation Mode compiles methods and enforces deck/liquid-class constraints; PyHamilton allows offline script runs (simulate=True) with Python tooling for linting/types. ([labautowiki.org](https://labautowiki.org/wiki/HSL_%26_Venus_%28Hamilton%29?utm_source=openai))
